tools.title: Word Counter
tools.seo_description: Free online word counter. Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs instantly as you type. No signup, runs in your browser.
tools.usage_instructions: Type or paste your text into the box and the counters update instantly as you type. Use it to check essay lengths, tweet limits, meta descriptions or any text with a size limit. Everything is processed locally in your browser - your text is never sent anywhere.

tools.title: Loan EMI Calculator
tools.seo_description: Calculate your loan's monthly EMI, total payment and interest instantly. Enter principal, rate and term to see results.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the loan amount, annual interest rate and term in years, then click Calculate. The monthly payment, total payment and total interest will be shown below.

tools.title: Temperature Converter
tools.seo_description: Quickly convert temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin. Enter a value and select units to get instant results.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter a temperature value, select the source unit and the target unit, then click Convert. The result will appear below. Invalid inputs show a friendly error message.

tools.title: Sentence Length Analyzer
tools.seo_description: Enter a paragraph to instantly see the shortest, longest and average sentence lengths in words.
tools.usage_instructions: Paste or type a paragraph into the box and click “Analyze”. The tool will display the shortest, longest, and average sentence lengths in words.

tools.title: Quadratic Equation Solver
tools.seo_description: Quickly solve ax² + bx + c = 0 for real or complex roots. Enter coefficients and get accurate results instantly.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the coefficients a, b, and c, then click “Calculate”. The tool will display the roots, handling real and complex solutions. Errors are shown if inputs are missing or invalid.

tools.title: JSON Beautifier
tools.seo_description: Paste your minified JSON and instantly get a readable, pretty-printed version. No external services, works entirely in your browser.
tools.usage_instructions: Paste minified JSON into the box below and click “Beautify” to format it with indentation. The formatted result appears below.

tools.title: BMI Calculator
tools.seo_description: Calculate your Body Mass Index instantly by entering weight in kilograms and height in centimeters. Get your BMI and health category.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter your weight in kilograms and height in centimeters, then click Calculate. Your BMI and the corresponding weight category will appear below.

tools.title: Date Difference Calculator
tools.seo_description: Calculate the number of days, weeks, and months between two dates instantly. Simple, free online tool.
tools.usage_instructions: Select a start date and an end date, then click “Calculate”. The tool will display the total days, weeks, and full months between the dates.

tools.title: ASCII Art Generator
tools.seo_description: Convert any text into ASCII art instantly with optional box styles. No ads, no sign‑up.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter your text, choose a style, and click Generate. The ASCII art will appear below. Empty input shows a friendly reminder.

tools.title: Expense Splitter
tools.seo_description: Quickly calculate how to split a total expense among friends. Supports even division or custom shares. No ads, just instant results.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the total amount and the number of people. Optionally, provide a comma‑separated list of custom splits. Press “Calculate” to see each person’s share.

tools.title: Palindrome Checker
tools.seo_description: Check instantly if any text is a palindrome, ignoring case and punctuation. Simple, free tool.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the text you want to test, then click “Check Palindrome”. The result will show true if it reads the same backward, ignoring case and punctuation.

tools.title: Area Unit Converter
tools.seo_description: Quickly convert area measurements between square feet, meters, acres, hectares, and more. Simple, accurate, and free.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter a numeric value, select the source unit and the target unit, then click Convert. The result will appear below.

tools.title: Markdown to HTML Converter
tools.seo_description: Convert Markdown text to clean HTML instantly in your browser. No server, no sign‑up – just paste and click.
tools.usage_instructions: Paste or type Markdown in the box below and click Convert to see the HTML output.

tools.title: Simple Interest Calculator
tools.seo_description: Calculate simple interest instantly by entering principal, annual rate, and years. Get accurate results in seconds.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the principal amount, annual interest rate (as %), and the number of years. Click Calculate to see the simple interest. All fields are required and must be numeric.

tools.title: Prime Number Checker
tools.seo_description: Check instantly if a number is prime and see its smallest divisor if not. Simple, fast, and mobile-friendly.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter an integer greater than 1 and press Check. The result will tell you if the number is prime, and if not, the smallest divisor.

tools.title: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
tools.seo_description: Quickly encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings back to readable text directly in your browser.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the text you want to encode or a Base64 string to decode, select the operation, and click the button. The result appears below. Errors are shown if the input is empty or invalid.

tools.title: Hex Color Picker
tools.seo_description: Enter a hex color code to instantly see its swatch and RGB values. Simple, fast, and mobile-friendly.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter a hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) and click “Show Color”. The swatch and RGB values will appear below.

tools.title: Password Strength Meter
tools.seo_description: Enter a password to instantly see its strength score, category, and tips to improve security.
tools.usage_instructions: Type a password into the field below. The meter will show a score, strength category, and suggestions to make it more secure.

tools.title: Text to Morse Code
tools.seo_description: Easily convert any text into Morse code with our free online tool. Type or paste your text and get the dot‑dash representation instantly.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the text you want to translate into Morse code, then click “Convert”. The result appears below. Only letters, numbers and basic punctuation are supported.

tools.title: Roman Numeral Converter
tools.seo_description: Convert numbers to Roman numerals and vice‑versa instantly. Enter an Arabic number (1‑3999) or a Roman numeral and get the result.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter an Arabic number (1‑3999) or a Roman numeral, then click Convert. The result will appear below. Invalid inputs show an error message.

tools.title: Text Case Converter
tools.seo_description: Convert any text to uppercase, lowercase, title case, or camelCase instantly. Simple, free online tool.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the text you want to change, pick a case from the dropdown, and click Convert. The converted text appears below.

tools.title: Password Generator
tools.seo_description: Generate a random password instantly with custom length and character options. Safe, fast, and easy to use.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the desired length, choose which character types to include, and click Generate. The password will appear below.

tools.title: Base Converter
tools.seo_description: Quickly convert numbers between binary, decimal, octal, and hexadecimal. Simple, free, and works offline.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter a number, choose its source base and the target base, then click Convert. The converted value appears below. Invalid input shows an error message.

tools.title: Pythagorean Triple Finder
tools.seo_description: Enter a side length and select a, b, or c to list all integer Pythagorean triples containing that side.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter a side length, choose which side (a, b, or c), and click “Find triples” to list all integer Pythagorean triples containing that side.

tools.title: Time Zone Converter
tools.seo_description: Convert any time between world time zones instantly. Simple, free, and works offline.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter a time (24‑hour HH:MM), type the source time‑zone and the target time‑zone, then click Convert. The result shows the equivalent time in the target zone.

tools.title: Offline URL Shortener
tools.seo_description: Create a short, unique code for any long URL directly in your browser—no server needed. Fast, private, and offline.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter the long URL in the field below and click “Shorten”. The tool will display a short code (e.g., /abc123) that you can use as a short link.

tools.title: Email Format Validator
tools.seo_description: Validate email address format instantly. Enter an email and see if it's syntactically correct. No signup required.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter an email address below and click Validate. The result will tell you if the format is correct.

tools.title: Prime Factorization Calculator
tools.seo_description: Enter any integer to instantly compute its prime factors. Simple, fast, and mobile-friendly.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter an integer and press “Calculate” to see its prime factors. The result shows each factor with its multiplicity.

tools.title: Age Calculator
tools.seo_description: Enter your birth date to instantly calculate your age in years, months, and days. Simple, accurate, and free.
tools.usage_instructions: Select your birth date using the calendar, then click “Calculate Age”. The result will show your age in years, months, and days.

tools.title: Word Frequency Analyzer
tools.seo_description: Enter text to instantly see how often each word appears. Simple, fast, and free word frequency analyzer.
tools.usage_instructions: Paste or type your text into the box, then click “Analyze”. The list of words with their counts will appear below.

tools.title: Phone Number Validator & Formatter
tools.seo_description: Validate any phone number and instantly get it formatted in international E.164 style. Fast client‑side tool with no ads.
tools.usage_instructions: Enter a phone number and optional country code, then click “Validate & Format”. The tool will tell you if the number is valid and show it in international format.

tools.title: JSON Minifier
tools.seo_description: Quickly compress JSON into a single-line minified string. Paste your JSON and get the minified version instantly.
tools.usage_instructions: Paste your JSON into the textarea and click “Minify”. The minified JSON will appear below. Errors are shown if the input is not valid JSON.
